  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 23, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On April 23, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Christine Rivera reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 09, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina, on behalf of the City of Inglewood, to host a Touch A Truck Event at 400
  W. Beach, Public Property, on Saturday, May 02, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a one (1) day event at
  Rogers Park (west parking lot). Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park.
  Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations, IPD will staff police personnel at this event for positive interaction with
  community members and their families (and children). No recommendations needed for
  Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at
  the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427002)
 Permits & License Committee  April 23, 2026
Minutes  Page 2 of 9

Item #2:  Frank Ledezma, on behalf of Swisher Productions, to host The Roast of Kevin Hart Event
  at 3900 W Manchester Blvd, Kia Forum; Private Property; on Sunday, May 10, 2026, from
  2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a one
  (1) day event at Rogers Park (west parking lot). Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use
  of the park. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. APPROVED:
  Applicant shall hire additional/adequate Kia Forum Security personnel to ensure the safety
  of attendees and to prevent underage alcohol consumption. There shall be NO drone usage
  for this event. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws. Conditions for amplified sound:
  Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of
  contact for the person responsible for sound and acoustics volume control. Code
  Enforcement staff to be deployed to address unpermitted vending (4 staff members). No
  recommendations needed for Fire approval.Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Fire
  approval: Maintain the site at all times, ensuring it is cleaned correctly immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, personal protective hygiene, and face mask-wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427010)

Item #3:  Julia Hernandez, on behalf of Los Angeles Philharmonic (YOLA) to host a YOLA
  Inglewood Yammy’s 5.15.2026 / YOLA Soiree 5.16.2026 Event at 101 S a Brea Ave;
  Beckmen YOLA Center; Private Property, on Friday May 15, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00
  p.m. and Saturday, May 16, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO: Approval for a two (2) day event within Beckman YOLA
  Center. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures; Applicant to hire adequate (minimum 6) security personnel for the
  safety of attendees. NO alcoholic beverages to be sold or served at this event, NO drone
  usage; IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol-high visibility will be
  requested as time permits; Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply
  with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29. Provide a direct point of contact of the person in charge of
  sound and acoustics volume control; No recommendations needed for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426955)

Item #5:  Juan Rodriguez, on behalf of RJ’s Demolition & Disposal, to host a DIA DEL JADINERO

  will be requested.; Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with

  cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426922)

Item #6:  Dr. Von Simmons, on behalf of California Back Women’s Health Project (CABWHP) to
  host a Paint the Town Purple Communiity Walk & Family Field Day Event at 700 Warren
  Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park; Public Property, on Sunday, May 17, 2026, from 10:00 a.m.
  to 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO; Approval for a one (1) day
  event at Edward Vincent Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park.
  Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations, Approved; Applicant will need to hire two (2) police officers for public safety
  and two (2) TCO's for traffic control-safety (ingress-egress of park parking lots). Applicant
  will need to hire adequate, professionally licensed security guards (a minimum of 14) to
  assist IPD with any potential crowd control. Security staffing will need to be deployed along
  the route through the park. Security will also need to monitor the park restrooms with a
  male & female security team to ensure participants' safety and deter any outside lewd
  conduct. No drone usage at this event; the IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra
  patrol and high visibility will be provided as time permits; Conditions for amplified sound:
  Manage noise reading; Comply with IMC 5-28 and IMC 5-29; No conditions for Fire
  approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426918)

Item #7:  Daniel Medina, on behalf of the City of Inglewood, to host a Memorial Day Service Event
  at 1 W Manchester Blvd.; South Lawn; Public Property, on Monday, May 25, 2026, from
  11:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. APPROVED Fire approval; Approval for one (1) day event within
  Inglewood City Hall South Lawn. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the
  right-of-way. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures; IPD will staff two (2) police officers and CH security officers for public
  safety. The IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol-high visibility will be
  requested. Maintain the site at all times, ensuring the site is cleaned correctly immediately
  at the end of the event. No conditions for Code approval; No recommendations needed for
  Fire approval. Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00427001)

Item #8:  Noemi Sanchez, on behalf of Northgate Gonzalez Markets to host a Happy Mother’s Day
  Flower Sale Event at 10801 S. Prairie; Private Property, on Saturday, May 09, 2026, from
  7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. and Sunday, May 10, 2026, from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. APPROVED
  Approval for a two (2) day event within the Northgate parking lot. Applicant responsible for
  crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable mitigation measures; APPROVED;
  Applicant shall ensure that traffic safety measures (plan) are in place for ingress & egress
  of vehicles where this event is expected to take place. There shall be NO vehicular traffic
  where customers will be walking in the area of this event. Applicant to hire adequate
  professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees. Security staff shall wear
  traffic safety vests for visibility and risk management. The IPD watch commander will be
  notified, and an extra patrol will be requested. Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws.
  No recommendations needed for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00427077)
